notes.title: Update Notes for 7/27
notes.content:

-Gamepad (specifically, XBox) support should work much better now, but let me know if it doesn't

Please let me know if y'all have any questions or concerns about this new build!

notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys!!

Long time no update! The new opening animatic has been added (which is still in progress by the way, but it helps bring the story together), plus some new narration voice over! I've already been notified of some bugs in this new build, so if you encounter anything game-breaking, please hold the left and right bumper on your controller and press select to reset whatever level you are on. If that doesn't fix the problem please please PLEASE let me know so I can investigate and fix!!

Much love,
-skullpixl

notes.title: Quick Demo Patch
notes.content:
